about: Minimized regression vectors of the issue #196 differential fuzz: one per divergence category the campaign found. Each runs in its own environment (its `did`); the Rust driver records the reference verdict into tests/goldens/differential/corpus.jsonl, and the TypeScript replay holds each to the category listed for it in tests/goldens/differential/divergences.json.

vectors.name: leb128_overlong_nat_value
vectors.note: nat 5 as the two-byte group 85 00. Reference accepts 5; the runtime refuses overlong_leb128 (intended, #103 decision 4).

vectors.name: leb128_overlong_type_count
vectors.note: An empty type table whose count is the two-byte group 80 00. Reference accepts; the runtime refuses in the header (intended, #103 decision 4).

vectors.name: leb128_wide_field_id
vectors.note: Field id 97 ("a") as a six-byte group e1 80 80 80 80 00: longer than a u32 field's five bytes, so the runtime reports invalid_length; the reference accepts. Same rule, non-minimal LEB128 (intended).

vectors.name: empty_method_name
vectors.note: A func reference to aaaaa-aa with an empty method name. Reference accepts; the runtime refuses invalid_length by decision (round-trip symmetry with validate and encode; candid-core's HostValue validator refuses it too).

vectors.name: contract_unknown_key
vectors.note: An unknown key on a type node. Contract::from_json refuses it (unknown field); schemaFromContract accepts it.

vectors.name: contract_orphan_type_node
vectors.note: A type node no declaration reaches. Contract::from_json refuses it (orphan_type_node); schemaFromContract accepts it.

vectors.name: contract_rootless_arena
vectors.note: A non-empty arena with no declaration and no actor. Contract::from_json refuses it (rootless_type_arena); schemaFromContract accepts it.

vectors.name: contract_identities_edit
vectors.note: A contract id that is not a contract id. Contract::from_json refuses it; schemaFromContract does not read identities, by design (contract.ts).

vectors.name: contract_producer_edit
vectors.note: A producer field of the wrong JSON type. Contract::from_json refuses it; schemaFromContract does not read producer, by design (contract.ts).
